series.name: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H
series.notes: Model scoping: doc SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W, the older 48 V Sunny Island family with a 3-digit display number that carries an F (Fault/error), W (Warning) or E (Event) prefix, plus a Level column 1-5. This numbering is COMPLETELY different from the 4-digit inverter event scheme in SERIES 1/2: here 201 is VBATMAX (battery voltage above measuring range), not an AC undervoltage. Slave variants add 'Slv1'/'Slv2'/'SL1'/'SL2' or 'S1'/'S2' to the same base number, meaning the same fault on a different cluster phase. Multicluster-box codes (8xx) apply only where an MC-BOX is fitted.

title.ur: Sunny Island ke transformer mein zyada temperature (F109)

meaning.en: The transformer in the device at L1 (master) is over-temperature because of overload or ambient temperature. The unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device ke transformer mein zyada temperature hai — overload ya ambient temperature ki wajah se. Unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Load demand beyond the Sunny Island rating at that phase.
causes.ur: Us phase par Sunny Island ki rating se zyada load demand.

causes.en: High ambient temperature in an unventilated plant or generator room.
causes.ur: Bina hawa ki plant room ya generator room mein zyada ambient temperature.

causes.en: Blocked or failed cooling fan on the unit.
causes.ur: Unit ka cooling fan band ya defective.

solutions.en: Isolate the unit from AC sources and loads, then restart it and watch whether the error returns — that separates a transient overload from a hardware fault.
solutions.ur: Unit ko AC sources aur loads se isolate karein, phir restart karke dekhein ke error wapas aata hai ya nahi — waise pata chalta hai ke masla transient overload hai ya hardware fault.

solutions.en: Clean the fans as the manual directs, using a soft brush, and confirm the fan actually spins freely with the power off.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq fans soft brush se saaf karein, aur power off par confirm karein ke fan azaad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Stagger the loads so total demand never peaks together, and check the ventilation clearance around the unit per the manual.
solutions.ur: Loads ko aise stagger karein ke poori demand ek saath peak na ho, aur manual ke mutabiq unit ke aas paas ventilation clearance check karein.

notes.en: W110 and W111 are the same fault on slave 1 and slave 2 in a cluster — they are warnings, not faults.
notes.ur: W110 aur W111 cluster mein slave 1 aur slave 2 par wohi fault hain — yeh warnings hain, faults nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Inverter bridge mein zyada temperature (F113)

meaning.en: The inverter bridge (heatsink) at L1 (master) is over-temperature because of overload or ambient temperature. The unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par inverter bridge (heatsink) mein zyada temperature hai — overload ya ambient temperature ki wajah se. Unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Sustained load above the inverter's continuous rating on one phase.
causes.ur: Kisi phase par inverter ki continuous rating se zyada mustaqal load.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the maximum permissible value in the install room.
causes.ur: Install room mein maximum permissible value se zyada ambient temperature.

causes.en: Airflow through the unit obstructed by cable routing or a wall too close to the heat sink.
causes.ur: Cable routing ya deewar ki wajah se unit ka airflow ruka hua hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island, restart it, and note whether the error returns at the same load level.
solutions.ur: Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karein, restart karein, aur note karein ke error usi load level par wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature and the heatsink temperature with an IR thermometer; a large gap between them means poor airflow rather than hot weather.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se ambient aur heatsink temperature measure karein; dono ka bara farq kamzor airflow ka nishani hai, garmi mausam ka nahi.

solutions.en: Clear all cable bundles away from the heat sink and restore the manual's clearance, then reduce the phase load by staggering the loads.
solutions.ur: Saare cable bundles heat sink se door karein aur manual ka clearance wapas karein, phir loads stagger karke us phase ka load kam karein.

notes.en: Same display number family as F109 but the manual distinguishes transformer over-temperature from inverter-bridge over-temperature — do not merge them.
notes.ur: F109 ke saath yeh display number family wohi hai lekin manual transformer over-temperature aur inverter-bridge over-temperature mein farq karta hai — dono ko merge na karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: AC current limitation on line L1 (F117)
title.ur: Line L1 par AC current limitation (F117)

meaning.en: The load power on line conductor L1 is too high for the master, so the Sunny Island limits AC current.
meaning.ur: Line conductor L1 par loads ki power master ke liye zyada hai, is liye Sunny Island AC current limit kar raha hai.

causes.en: Connected load power exceeds the Sunny Island inverter power.
causes.ur: Connected loads ki power Sunny Island inverter ki power se zyada hai.

causes.en: A short circuit in the load circuit or the AC installation.
causes.ur: Load circuit ya AC installation mein short circuit.

causes.en: High inrush from a motor or compressor starting while other loads already run.
causes.ur: Dusre loads already chal rahan hon aur motor ya compressor start hote waqt zyada inrush.

solutions.en: Isolate AC sources and loads, clean the fans, and restart the Sunny Island as the manual's first corrective measure.
solutions.ur: AC sources aur loads isolate karein, fans saaf karein, aur manual ke pehle corrective measure ke mutabiq Sunny Island restart karein.

solutions.en: With the island stopped, clamp-meter each phase and measure actual load current; compare it against the Sunny Island rating printed on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Island band kar ke clamp meter se har phase ka actual load current measure karein; usse Sunny Island ki rating se compare karein jo nameplate par likhi hai.

solutions.en: Check for a short circuit in the load circuit with an insulation tester, and reduce the load on the affected phase by moving circuits between phases.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se load circuit mein short circuit check karein, aur affected phase ka load kam karne ke liye circuits doosre phases par move karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: AC1 par inverter overvoltage (F121)

meaning.en: An overvoltage has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master. The manual's first instruction is to disconnect all AC sources and loads and restart.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par overvoltage aaya hai. Manual ka pehla instruction hai sabhi AC sources aur loads disconnect karke restart karein.

causes.en: An external source such as a generator or grid back-feeding AC1 through the bypass switch.
causes.ur: Bypass switch ke zariye AC1 par koi external source jaise generator ya grid back-feed kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bypass switch left in the wrong position so it bridges the internal transfer relay.
causes.ur: Bypass switch galat position mein chhoda gaya hai jis se woh internal transfer relay ko bridge kar raha hai.

causes.en: A generator whose AVR is not regulating, producing a sustained overvoltage.
causes.ur: Aisa generator jiska AVR regulate nahi kar raha, jis se mustaqal overvoltage ban raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, exactly as the manual states as the first step.
solutions.ur: Manual ke pehle step ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Find the overvoltage source by measurement, connecting the AC sources and loads back one at a time while watching the AC1 voltage on a clamp meter or grid analyzer.
solutions.ur: AC sources aur loads ko ek-ek karke wapas jodte hue AC1 voltage ko clamp meter ya grid analyzer par dekhte hue, measurement se overvoltage ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: Set the bypass switch to the position for operation with the Sunny Island and confirm the generator AVR is regulating voltage before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Bypass switch ko Sunny Island ke saath chalane ki position par set karein aur dobara jodne se pehle confirm karein ke generator AVR voltage regulate kar raha hai.

notes.en: Related to the VtgOnAC1Det family (F158/F159/F160), which reports the same unwanted voltage as a warning.
notes.ur: VtgOnAC1Det family (F158/F159/F160) se mile julay hain, jo wohi unwanted voltage warning ki shakal mein report karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: AC1 par inverter overfrequency (F129)

meaning.en: An overfrequency has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master, so the Sunny Island has shut down.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par overfrequency aaya hai, is liye Sunny Island band ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator running with a failed governor or an incorrect frequency setpoint.
causes.ur: Generator aisa chal raha hai jiska governor ya frequency setpoint ghalat hai.

causes.en: Generator overloaded so the governor cannot hold the frequency setpoint.
causes.ur: Generator overloaded hai is liye governor frequency setpoint nahi pakad pa raha.

causes.en: An external energy source connected to AC1 instead of AC2.
causes.ur: AC2 ki jagah AC1 par koi external energy source joda gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Locate the overfrequency source by measurement, reconnecting AC sources and loads step by step while logging frequency at AC1 on a grid analyzer.
solutions.ur: Grid analyzer par AC1 ki frequency log karte hue AC sources aur loads ko qadam ba qadam wapas jod kar measurement se overfrequency ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, adjust the generator frequency and confirm its governor holds the setpoint under load before recommissioning.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to generator frequency adjust karein aur recommission se pehle confirm karein ke uska governor load ke under setpoint pakad leta hai.

notes.en: F133 is the underfrequency counterpart; both are hard faults in this manual while the 3xx Ext* events are warnings.
notes.ur: F133 is underfrequency ka counterpart hai; is manual mein dono hard faults hain jabke 3xx Ext* events warnings hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: AC1 par inverter underfrequency (F133)

meaning.en: An underfrequency has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master, so the Sunny Island has shut down.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par underfrequency aaya hai, is liye Sunny Island band ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator overloaded so its frequency sags below the configured threshold.
causes.ur: Generator overloaded hai jis se uski frequency configured threshold se neeche gir gayi.

causes.en: External voltage/connection problem dragging frequency down at the island's AC input.
causes.ur: Island ke AC input par external voltage ya connection ka masla frequency neeche kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Generator failed to start properly or dropped out during the connection sequence.
causes.ur: Generator theek se start nahi hua ya connection sequence ke dauran gir gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Find the underfrequency source by measurement, reconnecting AC sources and loads step by step while logging frequency at AC1.
solutions.ur: AC1 par frequency log karte hue AC sources aur loads ko qadam ba qadam wapas jod kar measurement se underfrequency ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, reduce the connected load, then check its governor droop and its warm-up time parameter 234.12 GnWarmTm so it reaches a valid voltage before connection.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to connected load kam karein, phir uska governor droop aur warm-up time parameter 234.12 GnWarmTm check karein ke woh connection se pehle valid voltage tak pahunche.

notes.en: The GnWarmTm connection appears in the manual under W402 GnFailLock, the generator block — check both together when start-ups keep failing.
notes.ur: GnWarmTm connection manual mein W402 GnFailLock, generator block ke under hai — start-ups fail hote rahen to dono saath check karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: DC connection par overcurrent (F162)

meaning.en: Too much current is flowing through the DC connection of the master. A fault-level event, not a load-level one.
meaning.ur: Master ke DC connection se bohat zyada current beh raha hai. Yeh load level ka nahi, fault level ka event hai.

causes.en: A short circuit on the DC side of the battery or the DC sources.
causes.ur: Battery ya DC sources ke DC side par short circuit.

causes.en: DC wiring connected with reversed polarity, driving current into a device not designed for it.
causes.ur: DC wiring reversed polarity se jodi hui hai, jis se aise device mein current ja raha hai jo is ke liye bana nahi.

causes.en: Incorrect battery capacity or type for the Sunny Island, so charging current exceeds the design.
causes.ur: Sunny Island ke liye ghalat battery capacity ya type, jis se charging current design se zyada ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery at the BatFuse load-break switch first, then isolate AC and PV, before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Pehle BatFuse load-break switch se battery isolate karein, phir AC aur PV isolate karein, uske baad hi koi measurement karein.

solutions.en: With the DC side dead, measure continuity and insulation resistance on every DC conductor to find the shorted core, and verify polarity at each termination.
solutions.ur: DC side dead kar ke har DC conductor ki continuity aur insulation resistance measure karein taake short wala core mil jaye, aur har termination par polarity verify karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the installed battery type and capacity against the Sunny Island technical data and the battery manufacturer's charge-current limit.
solutions.ur: Lagai gayi battery ka type aur capacity Sunny Island ke technical data aur battery manufacturer ke charge-current limit se verify karein.

notes.en: Do not jump straight to 'replace the battery' — the manual's chain is isolate, then locate the short, then verify the battery spec.
notes.ur: Seedha 'battery badal dein' par na jayein — manual ka tareeqa hai isolate karo, phir short dhoondein, phir battery spec verify karo.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: 5-minute rating se zyada overload (F166)

meaning.en: The device at L1 (master) has been loaded beyond its five-minute rated capacity, so it derates or shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device apni 5-minute rated capacity se zyada load ho chuka hai, is liye woh derate ya band ho jata hai.

causes.en: A motor or compressor with a high inrush drawing a large block of power for a short period.
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor jiska inrush zyada hai aur jo chhoti duri ke liye bada power kheenchta hai.

causes.en: Several loads switching on at the same time after a supply interruption.
causes.ur: Supply interruption ke baad kai loads ek saath on ho jana.

causes.en: Sustained demand above the unit's continuous rating, not just its short-term rating.
causes.ur: Unit ki sirf short-term rating nahi, continuous rating se bhi zyada mustaqal demand.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, which is the manual's stated corrective measure for this event.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein — yehi is event ke liye manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Log which loads switch on simultaneously and add time staggering or soft-start to the largest motor, as the manual suggests for high-inrush loads.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kaun se loads ek saath on hote hain, aur sab se bade motor par soft-start ya staggering lagayein, jaise manual high-inrush loads ke liye kehta hai.

solutions.en: If the five-minute overload repeats at modest demand, clamp-meter each phase under real load and compare against the manual's overload figures in the technical data.
solutions.ur: Agar moqtabil demand par bhi 5-minute overload repeat ho to real load ke under har phase ka clamp-meter reading lein aur technical data ke overload figures se compare karein.

notes.en: Three separate overload codes exist: 5-minute (F166), 30-minute (F169) and short-term (F172). The duration is the diagnostic difference.
notes.ur: Teen alag overload codes hain: 5-minute (F166), 30-minute (F169) aur short-term (F172). Duration hi diagnosis ka farq hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: 30-minute rating se zyada overload (F169)

meaning.en: The device at L1 (master) has been loaded beyond its 30-minute rated capacity.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device apni 30-minute rated capacity se zyada load ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Sustained demand between the 5-minute and 30-minute ratings — a capacity sizing problem, not a motor inrush problem.
causes.ur: 5-minute aur 30-minute rating ke darmiyan mustaqal demand — yeh capacity sizing ka masla hai, motor inrush ka nahi.

causes.en: A high-power base load that never switches off, with a large appliance added on top.
causes.ur: Bohat high-power base load jo kabhi off na ho, aur us par bada appliance lag jaye.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq connected load kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the 30-minute average demand with a clamp meter and logging meter; if it sits above the 30-minute rating, the unit is simply too small for this site.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter aur logging meter se 30-minute ki average demand measure karein; agar woh 30-minute rating se upar baithti hai to is site ke liye unit chhota hai.

solutions.en: Decide between staggering the loads and adding a further Sunny Island to the cluster, which the manual itself suggests for frequent derating.
solutions.ur: Loads stagger karne aur cluster mein aik aur Sunny Island jodne ke darmiyan faisla karein, jaise manual baar baar derate hone par khud kehta hai.

notes.en: Distinguishing 5-minute from 30-minute overload tells the owner whether to fix a switching problem or upsize the plant.
notes.ur: 5-minute aur 30-minute overload mein farq karne se malik ko pata chalta hai ke switching ka masla hai ya plant bara karna hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: Current sensor not connected or defective (F176)
title.ur: Current sensor connected nahi ya defective (F176)

meaning.en: The current sensor is not connected, not available, or defective, so the Sunny Island cannot measure its own AC current. Level 4 fault.
meaning.ur: Current sensor connected nahi, available nahi, ya defective hai, is liye Sunny Island apna AC current nahi naap sakta. Level 4 fault.

causes.en: Current sensor transformer (CT) not fitted or not terminated in the AC installation.
causes.ur: AC installation mein current sensor transformer (CT) laga hi nahi ya terminate nahi hua.

causes.en: CT wiring open, or the sensor cable disconnected inside the unit.
causes.ur: CT wiring khuli hai, ya sensor cable unit ke andar se nikal gayi hai.

causes.en: The sensor has failed or drifted out of calibration, so measured current is wrong.
causes.ur: Sensor fail ho gaya ya calibration se bahar chala gaya, jis se measured current ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island before touching the current sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Current sensor wiring par kaam karne se pehle Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the CT installation and termination against the installation manual: correct ratio, correct direction, screws tight, cable undamaged.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq CT installation aur termination check karein: sahi ratio, sahi direction, screws mazboot, cable undamaged.

solutions.en: Verify the measured current against a clamp meter at the same instant; if the readings disagree by more than a few percent the sensor or its wiring is the problem, not the load.
solutions.ur: Usi waqt clamp meter ke saath measured current verify karein; agar readings mein kuch percent se zyada farq hai to masla sensor ya uski wiring ka hai, load ka nahi.

notes.en: Because the island regulates on measured current, a wrong reading causes spurious overload events (F166/F169) as well as bad battery charge control.
notes.ur: Kyunke island measured current par regulate karta hai, ghalat reading se khufay overload events (F166/F169) aur battery charging ka kharaab control bhi hota hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Multicluster pre-fuse F104.1 khula (F179)

meaning.en: The pre-fuse F104.1 in the Multicluster-Box is open. The main-cluster master detects voltage at ExtVtg and tries to switch to L1, where an anti-islanding error occurs because of the open pre-fuse.
meaning.ur: Multicluster-Box ka pre-fuse F104.1 khula hai. Main cluster ka master ExtVtg par voltage detect karke L1 par switch kne ki koshish karta hai, jahan khule pre-fuse ki wajah se anti-islanding error aata hai.

causes.en: Pre-fuse F104.1 has actually tripped from an overcurrent or short circuit in the cluster wiring.
causes.ur: Cluster wiring mein overcurrent ya short circuit ki wajah se pre-fuse F104.1 sach mein trip ho gaya.

causes.en: Pre-fuse holder not seated correctly during a past service operation.
causes.ur: Kisi pichli service ke dauran pre-fuse holder theek se baithaya nahi gaya.

causes.en: Cluster cable nicked during installation, loading the fuse to its breaking current.
causes.ur: Installation mein cluster cable mein nishan, jis se fuse apni breaking current par aa gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources, loads and battery from the island, then confirm zero volts at the Multicluster-Box before touching any fuse.
solutions.ur: Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein, phir koi fuse chherne se pehle Multicluster-Box par zero volt confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the insulation and continuity of the cluster conductors with an insulation tester before re-fitting the fuse — do not simply re-energise and hope.
solutions.ur: Fuse dobara lagane se pehle cluster conductors ki insulation aur continuity insulation tester se measure karein — bas energise karke umeed na lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the voltage supply at terminal AC2 of the master in the main cluster, which is the measurement the manual asks for after reactivating the fuse.
solutions.ur: Pre-fuse dobara lagane ke baad manual jo measurement mangta hai woh hai: main cluster ke master ke terminal AC2 par voltage supply check karein.

notes.en: W180 and W181 are the same fault on the L2 and L3 pre-fuses F104.2 and F104.3 — the pre-fuse number tells you which phase is dead.
notes.ur: W180 aur W181 wohi fault L2 aur L3 pre-fuses F104.2 aur F104.3 par hain — pre-fuse ka number batata hai ke kaun si phase marr chuki hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Battery voltage measuring range se upar (F201)

meaning.en: The battery voltage at the master is above the permissible measurement range, so the Sunny Island stops regulating on it.
meaning.ur: Master par battery voltage permissible measurement range se upar hai, is liye Sunny Island us par regulate karna chhod deta hai.

causes.en: Battery bank over-celled for the 48 V system — the manual tells you to read parameter 120.02 BatVtg and compare against 65.0 V.
causes.ur: Battery bank 48 V system ke liye zyada cells ka hai — manual kehti hai ke parameter 120.02 BatVtg padh kar 65.0 V se compare karein.

causes.en: DC sources configured with too high a charge voltage.
causes.ur: DC sources bohat zyada charge voltage ke saath configure hain.

causes.en: Battery capacity too small for the connected DC sources, so the sources drive the bus voltage up.
causes.ur: Battery capacity connected DC sources ke liye chhoti hai, jis se sources bus voltage upar le jaate hain.

causes.en: A cell shorted or a cell interconnector open, so the string voltage no longer divides evenly.
causes.ur: Koi cell short ho gaya ya cell interconnector khul gaya, jis se string voltage ab barabar baant nahi hota.

solutions.en: Isolate DC sources, then read parameter 120.02 BatVtg on the Sunny Island and note the value before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: DC sources isolate karein, phir Sunny Island par parameter 120.02 BatVtg padh kar kuch karne se pehle value note karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is above 65.0 V, measure each battery cell with a cell voltage meter; the healthy spread on a 48 V lead-acid bank is small and a single low cell means the bank is over-celled or a cell is shorted.
solutions.ur: Agar reading 65.0 V se upar hai to cell voltage meter se har battery cell ka voltage measure karein; 48 V lead-acid bank par healthy spread chhota hota hai aur aik kam cell ka matlab bank over-celled hai ya koi cell short hai.

solutions.en: Check the DC source charge-voltage settings against the battery manufacturer's permitted maximum, and correct them before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: DC source ke charge-voltage settings ko battery manufacturer ke permitted maximum se check karein aur dobara jodne se pehle theek karein.

solutions.en: Verify the battery capacity against the DC source datasheet as the manual directs, and replace a bank that is genuinely under-sized for the site.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq battery capacity ko DC source datasheet se verify karein, aur jo bank is site ke liye sach mein chhota ho use badal dein.

notes.en: Do not confuse with the 4-digit Sunny Tripower code 202, which is an AC undervoltage on a completely different product.
notes.ur: 4-digit Sunny Tripower ke code 202 se na milayein, jo bilkul alag product par AC undervoltage hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Battery bohat garam ho gaya — fault (F206)

meaning.en: The battery temperature is too high. SMA explicitly recommends protecting the battery from temperatures above 25 C because that prevents premature ageing.
meaning.ur: Battery ka temperature bohat zyada hai. SMA khud salah deti hai ke battery ko 25 C se upar temperature se bachaayein, kyunke is se jaldi ageing hoti hai.

causes.en: Battery room with poor ventilation in a hot climate, common in Pakistani summers.
causes.ur: Garmi ke mausam mein battery room ki hawa kam, jo Pakistan mein aam hai.

causes.en: Battery mounted too close to a heat source or in direct sun.
causes.ur: Battery kisi heat source ke qareeb ya seedhi dhoop mein lagi hai.

causes.en: Battery temperature sensor reading wrong — the manual asks for a specific resistance check.
causes.ur: Battery temperature sensor ki reading ghalat hai — manual ek khaas resistance check mangta hai.

causes.en: Battery itself ageing internally, generating heat under charge.
causes.ur: Battery khud andar se ageing kar rahi hai aur charge mein garmi paida kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the battery to cool down, as the manual's first instruction; do not force charge into a hot battery.
solutions.ur: Manual ka pehla instruction hai battery ko thanda hone ka intezaar karein; garmi wali battery par zor se charge na dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery temperature sensor resistance: the manual states it should be approximately 2000 Ohm at 20 to 25 C. If it is far from that, replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Battery temperature sensor ki resistance measure karein: manual ke mutabiq 20 se 25 C par taqreeban 2000 Ohm honi chahiye. Agar is se kaafi door ho to sensor badal dein.

solutions.en: Install a thermometer in the battery room and log peak temperature; if it regularly exceeds 25 C, add ventilation or move the bank to a cooler, shaded room.
solutions.ur: Battery room mein thermometer lagayein aur peak temperature log karein; agar woh baar baar 25 C cross kare to ventilation badhayein ya bank ko thande, shadowed room mein shift karein.

notes.en: This is a battery lifetime issue as much as a safety issue — repeated trips to F206 will end the battery far earlier than its rated cycle count.
notes.ur: Yeh battery ki lifetime ka masla bhi hai aur safety ka bhi — baar baar F206 aana battery ko rated cycles se kahin pehle khatam kar dega.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: Battery voltage above target charge voltage (F208)
title.ur: Battery voltage target charge voltage se upar (F208)

meaning.en: The battery voltage is higher than the target charge voltage. The manual groups the external-source and configuration corrective measures under this code.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage target charge voltage se zyada hai. Manual is code ke neeche external source aur configuration ke corrective measures deta hai.

causes.en: DC sources not correctly configured for the battery chemistry, so they charge to the wrong voltage.
causes.ur: DC sources battery chemistry ke liye theek se configure nahi hain, jis se woh galat voltage tak charge karte hain.

causes.en: Some SMA inverters in the cluster not set to the stand-alone country data set, which the manual calls out explicitly.
causes.ur: Cluster mein kuch SMA inverters stand-alone country data set par set nahi hain, jise manual saaf likhta hai.

causes.en: Battery not actually connected, so the DC sources are charging into nothing and the voltage is external.
causes.ur: Battery asal mein judi hi nahi hai, jis se DC sources kisi cheez ko charge kar rahe hain aur voltage external hai.

solutions.en: Isolate DC sources and the battery, then measure the actual battery voltage directly at the battery terminals with a DC meter.
solutions.ur: DC sources aur battery isolate karein, phir DC meter se battery terminals par seedha actual battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check every DC source's charge voltage setting against the battery manufacturer's permitted maximum and correct any that are too high.
solutions.ur: Har DC source ka charge voltage setting battery manufacturer ke permitted maximum se check karein aur jo zyada ho use theek karein.

solutions.en: In an off-grid system, ensure all SMA inverters in the cluster are configured to the country data set for stand-alone operation, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Off-grid system mein ensure karein ke cluster ke sabhi SMA inverters stand-alone operation ke country data set par hain, jaise manual kehta hai.

notes.en: W209 means the high battery voltage was NOT generated by the device itself, which is a strong hint that the voltage is external.
notes.ur: W209 ka matlab hai ke high battery voltage device ne khud paida nahi ki, jo strong nishani hai ke voltage external hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat gir gaya (F213)

meaning.en: The battery voltage is too low. The unit has shut down on a depleted bank.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage bohat kam hai. Unit khali ho chuke bank par band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged because loads exceeded supply for too long.
causes.ur: Battery gehrai se discharge ho gaya kyunke loads bohat der ke liye supply se zyada rahe.

causes.en: Bank aged or undersized, so it cannot hold charge under the site's load.
causes.ur: Bank purana ya chhota hai, jis se woh site ke load ke neeche charge nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: A cell open-circuited, so the bank capacity has dropped without any voltage symptom at full charge.
causes.ur: Koi cell open ho gaya, jis se bank ki capacity girti hai aur full charge par koi voltage ka nishaan nahi milta.

causes.en: No load-shedding contactor fitted, so DC loads keep draining the bank after it drops.
causes.ur: Koi load-shedding contactor nahi lagi, jis se voltage girne ke baad bhi DC loads bank ko drain karte rehte hain.

solutions.en: Charge the battery in emergency charge mode as the manual's first instruction, or use an external battery charger — do not repeatedly start the island and deepen the discharge.
solutions.ur: Manual ke pehle instruction ke mutabiq battery ko emergency charge mode mein charge karein, ya external battery charger use karein — baar baar island start karke discharge aur ghera mat karein.

solutions.en: Ensure DC loads are shed via a load-shedding contactor when the state of charge is low, as the manual explicitly requires.
solutions.ur: Ensure karein ke state of charge kam hone par DC loads load-shedding contactor ke zariye shed ho jayein, jaise manual saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: After charging, measure each cell's voltage and specific gravity; a cell far below its neighbours must be replaced, not the whole bank.
solutions.ur: Charge ke baad har cell ka voltage aur specific gravity measure karein; padosi cells se kaafi neeche wala cell badalna hai, poora bank nahi.

notes.en: F716/F717/F718 (VBATMIN) are the measuring-range-below variant; use those when the reading has collapsed out of range rather than merely being low.
notes.ur: F716/F717/F718 (VBATMIN) measuring-range-below wale variant hain; jab reading range se bahar gir gayi ho sirf kam hone ke bajaye woh codes use karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: External battery mgmt detected but not configured (F221)
title.ur: External battery management detect hui magar configure nahi (F221)

meaning.en: An external battery management system is detected but was never configured, so the Sunny Island cannot use it.
meaning.ur: External battery management system detect ho gayi magar configure hi nahi ki gayi, is liye Sunny Island usay use nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: A lithium-ion battery with its own BMS fitted, but the cluster was commissioned without selecting external energy management.
causes.ur: Apni BMS ke saath lithium-ion battery lagi hui hai, magar cluster commission karte waqt external energy management select nahi ki gayi.

causes.en: Battery swapped from a lead-acid system without reconfiguring the cluster.
causes.ur: Cluster reconfigure kiye baghair lead-acid system se battery badal di gayi.

causes.en: A BMS is reporting on the SiCom bus that the master was not expecting to see.
causes.ur: SiCom bus par aik BMS report kar rahi hai jise master expect nahi kar raha tha.

solutions.en: Start the QCG (Quick Configuration Guide) and reconfigure the system for external energy management, which is the manual's stated corrective measure.
solutions.ur: QCG (Quick Configuration Guide) start karke system ko external energy management ke liye dobara configure karein — yehi manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Confirm with the battery manufacturer that the BMS is a model the Sunny Island supports and that its data cable is connected to the correct port.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer se confirm karein ke BMS wohi model hai jo Sunny Island support karta hai aur uska data cable sahi port par judi hai.

solutions.en: If the system is genuinely lead-acid, disconnect the external BMS data cable and reconfigure, otherwise the event will persist.
solutions.ur: Agar system sach mein lead-acid hai to external BMS ka data cable nikaal kar dobara configure karein, warna event barqarar rahega.

notes.en: Distinguish from the XA/XW 9xx block, which are messages forwarded FROM the BMS rather than this configuration mismatch.
notes.ur: XA/XW 9xx block se farq karein, jo BMS se aane wale messages hain, is configuration mismatch se nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: External voltage ya frequency configured range se bahar (F314)

meaning.en: The generator or utility grid voltage and/or frequency at the island's external connection is outside the configured range, so the island disconnects from it.
meaning.ur: Island ke external connection par generator ya utility grid ka voltage aur/ya frequency configured range se bahar hai, is liye island us se disconnect ho jata hai.

causes.en: Generator voltage regulator drifting, so the terminal voltage sits outside the configured window.
causes.ur: Generator ka voltage regulator drift kar raha hai, jis se terminal voltage configured window se bahar rehta hai.

causes.en: Configured generator voltage/frequency thresholds too narrow for a small or overloaded generator.
causes.ur: Chhote ya overloaded generator ke liye configured voltage ya frequency thresholds bohat tang hain.

causes.en: External grid genuinely outside limits, e.g. a weak or overloaded feeder.
causes.ur: External grid sach mein limits se bahar hai, maslan kamzor ya overloaded feeder.

solutions.en: Adjust the generator voltage and/or generator frequency, which the manual lists as the first corrective measure for a generator source.
solutions.ur: Generator source ke liye manual ka pehla corrective measure hai: generator voltage aur/ya generator frequency adjust karein.

solutions.en: Observe and log measured values 134.02 ExtVtg and 134.04 ExtFrq during operation; these are the two parameters the manual tells you to watch.
solutions.ur: Operation ke dauran measured values 134.02 ExtVtg aur 134.04 ExtFrq observe aur log karein; manual kehti hai ke yahi do parameters dekhein.

solutions.en: Adjust the generator voltage/frequency thresholds on the Sunny Island per the installation manual, then re-run the generator connection sequence.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island par generator voltage ya frequency thresholds adjust karein, phir generator connection sequence dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: In a battery backup system where the source is the utility rather than a generator, contact SMA Service as the manual directs instead of changing thresholds.
solutions.ur: Battery backup system mein jahan source generator ke bajaye utility hai wahan thresholds badalne ke bajaye manual ke mutabiq SMA Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: F314 is the fault-level external voltage event; W315-W321 are the warning-level low/high voltage and frequency variants with a phase suffix.
notes.ur: F314 fault-level external voltage event hai; W315-W321 warning-level low/high voltage aur frequency variants hain jinmein phase ka suffix hota hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: External source has wrong rotating magnetic field (W355)
title.ur: External source ka rotating magnetic field ghalat (W355)

meaning.en: The assignment of the external source's line conductors to the Sunny Island AC2 connections does not produce a right-rotating magnetic field, i.e. the phase sequence is wrong.
meaning.ur: External source ke line conductors ko Sunny Island ke AC2 connections par jo tarah se joda gaya hai us se right-rotating magnetic field nahi banta, yaani phase sequence ghalat hai.

causes.en: Master, slave 1 and slave 2 connected to L1, L2, L3 in the wrong order.
causes.ur: Master, slave 1 aur slave 2 ko L1, L2, L3 se ghalat tarteeb par joda gaya hai.

causes.en: Two phases transposed in the AC2 cable termination.
causes.ur: AC2 cable termination mein do phases aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Generator output leads to the island connected in the wrong phase order.
causes.ur: Generator ke output leads island par ghalat phase order mein jode gaye hain.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources and loads first; with power off, verify the phase assignment at every AC2 termination against the manual.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC sources aur loads isolate karein; power off par har AC2 termination par phase assignment ko manual se verify karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the correct mapping explicitly: the manual states master to L1, slave 1 to L2, slave 2 to L3.
solutions.ur: Sahi mapping saaf confirm karein: manual kehti hai master L1 par, slave 1 L2 par, slave 2 L3 par.

solutions.en: Verify with a phase-sequence meter or by measuring L-L voltage magnitude on each pair; on a correct sequence all pairs read similar and the island will accept the source.
solutions.ur: Phase-sequence meter se verify karein, ya har jorre par L-L voltage magnitude measure karke; sahi sequence mein har jorre ka reading similar hota hai aur island source qubool karega.

notes.en: A classic field error on three-phase installations. Getting it wrong trips W331-W333 anti-islanding as well.
notes.ur: Teesre phase installations par yeh aam field error hai. Ghalat hua to W331-W333 anti-islanding bhi trip karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: AC voltage present while tie switch is open (F366)
title.ur: Tie switch khula hone par bhi AC voltage maujood (F366)

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC bus at L1 (master) even though the tie switch is open, which the manual treats as a fault.
meaning.ur: Tie switch khula hone ke bawajood L1 (master) par AC bus par voltage maujood hai, jise manual fault maanta hai.

causes.en: External source still energising the AC bus through a parallel path.
causes.ur: External source kisi parallel raaste se AC bus ko abhi bhi energize kar raha hai.

causes.en: Feedback from another Sunny Island in the cluster through the bypass switch or tie switch wiring.
causes.ur: Bypass switch ya tie switch wiring ke zariye cluster ke doosre Sunny Island se feedback.

causes.en: Capacitive coupling or induced voltage on an unenergised bus, which the RCD/leakage path holds up.
causes.ur: Bina voltage ke bus par capacitive coupling ya induced voltage, jise RCD ya leakage path upar rakhta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC sources, loads and the battery from the island, then confirm the tie switch is genuinely open and mechanically secured.
solutions.ur: Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein, phir confirm karein ke tie switch waqai khula hai aur mechanically secured hai.

solutions.en: With power off, verify the tie switch triggering and its wiring as the manual's first corrective measure, then check the feedback contact is correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Power off par manual ke pehle corrective measure ke mutabiq tie switch ka triggering aur uski wiring verify karein, phir feedback contact ki sahi tarah se connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the AC bus with a high-impedance meter to distinguish a real back-feed from induced voltage; a real source holds several volts, induced voltage collapses when the meter is disconnected.
solutions.ur: Asli back-feed aur induced voltage mein farq karne ke liye high-impedance meter se AC bus par voltage measure karein; asli source kai volts pakadta hai, induced voltage meter nikalte hi gir jata hai.

notes.en: F367 ExtCtcNotOpen is the companion 'tie switch does not open' fault — both point at the tie switch assembly and its feedback contact.
notes.ur: F367 ExtCtcNotOpen saathi fault hai 'tie switch nahi khulta' — dono tie switch assembly aur uske feedback contact ki taraf ishara karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.ur: Multicluster-Box ka plausibility check fail (F801)

meaning.en: The plausibility check on the contactors inside the Multicluster-Box has failed, so the cluster switching hardware state is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Multicluster-Box ke contactors ka plausibility check fail ho gaya, is liye cluster ki switching hardware state par bharosa nahi kiya jata.

causes.en: A contactor in the Multicluster-Box welded or failed to release, so its feedback does not match the commanded state.
causes.ur: Multicluster-Box mein koi contactor weld ho gaya ya release nahi hua, jis se uska feedback commanded state se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Contactors mechanically stuck or their auxiliary feedback contacts wired incorrectly.
causes.ur: Contactors mechanically atak gaye ya unke auxiliary feedback contacts ghalat tare se jode gaye hain.

causes.en: Loose auxiliary contactor wiring in the box producing an intermittent, implausible reading.
causes.ur: Box mein auxiliary contactor wiring loose, jis se baar baar implausible reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources, loads and the battery from the Sunny Island and confirm the Multicluster-Box is dead before opening it.
solutions.ur: Sunny Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein aur Multicluster-Box kholne se pehle confirm karein ke woh dead hai.

solutions.en: Visually and manually check each contactor in the box: does it pull in, does it latch, and does the auxiliary feedback contact change state when it does.
solutions.ur: Box mein har contactor visually aur manually check karein: kya woh pull-in karta hai, latch karta hai, aur hone par uska auxiliary feedback contact state change karta hai.

solutions.en: With the box isolated, measure continuity through each main contact pair with the coil energised and de-energised; a contactor that never opens the main path must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Box isolate kar ke coil on aur off dono states mein har main contact pair se continuity measure karein; jo contactor main path kabhi nahi khulta use badalna hoga.

notes.en: F806, F809, F815-F818 are the more specific Multicluster-Box faults (coding conflict, Q10 load-shedding contactor, Q5/Q7/Q9 contactors, phase missing) — check them together with this one.
notes.ur: F806, F809, F815-F818 zyada specific Multicluster-Box faults hain (coding conflict, Q10 load-shedding contactor, Q5/Q7/Q9 contactors, phase missing) — inhein is ke saath check karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

title.en: Internal error in battery management, via SiCom (F931)
title.ur: Battery management mein internal error, SiCom ke zariye (F931)

meaning.en: An internal error in the battery management system has been forwarded to the Sunny Island over SiCom. The island cannot diagnose it; the battery management must.
meaning.ur: Battery management system ka internal error SiCom ke zariye Sunny Island tak pohanchaya gaya hai. Island isay diagnose nahi kar sakta; battery management ko karna hoga.

causes.en: Internal fault inside the lithium-ion battery BMS firmware.
causes.ur: Lithium-ion battery ke BMS firmware ka internal fault.

causes.en: Cell monitoring unit reporting inconsistent cell voltages to the BMS.
causes.ur: Cell monitoring unit BMS ko inconsistent cell voltages bhej raha hai.

causes.en: SiCom data cable intermittent, causing the BMS message to be decoded wrongly.
causes.ur: SiCom data cable intermittent, jis se BMS message galat decode hota hai.

solutions.en: Eliminate the cause of the error in the external battery management system using the battery manufacturer's documentation — this is the manual's own instruction for the whole XA block.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer ki documentation istemal kar ke external battery management system mein error ki wajah door karein — yehi poore XA block ke liye manual ka apna instruction hai.

solutions.en: Check the SiCom data cable between battery and Sunny Island: seating, shielding, and continuity, since a marginal cable can produce phantom BMS errors.
solutions.ur: Battery aur Sunny Island ke darmiyan SiCom data cable check karein: seating, shielding aur continuity, kyunke marginal cable se khauf BMS errors bante hain.

solutions.en: Contact the battery manufacturer for the BMS event log; the XA code maps 1:1 to their error list, so their log is the only useful evidence.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer se BMS event log maangein; XA code un ki error list se 1:1 map hota hai, is liye un ka log hi useful evidence hai.

notes.en: The XA block (920-935) and the XW block (936-951) are mirrored pairs: XA = error level, XW = warning level for the same underlying battery condition. Codes 920-928 and 935 are documented; 933 and 934 are not in the manual.
notes.ur: XA block (920-935) aur XW block (936-951) aapas mein mirror hain: XA = error level, XW = warning level usi battery condition ka. Codes 920-928 aur 935 documented hain; 933 aur 934 manual mein nahi hain.
